title: Delhi High Court denies bail to Athar Khan in Delhi riots conspiracy case
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday denied bail to Athar Khan, one of the accused in the Delhi riots conspiracy case.A Division Bench of Justices Prathiba M Singh and Madhu Jain said that Khan's role in causing the death of people was prima facie established and that he is a flight risk. The Court held that the evidence against Khan, including chats recovered from co-accused Ovais Sultan Khan and the statement of protected witness "Pluto", established his role as a key conspirator in the violence.
